content: {"paper_id":"W2897959996","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"label-distribution-learning","exact_quote":"Historical Context-based Style Classification of Painting Images via Label Distribution Learning","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确将画作风格分类表述为通过标记分布学习完成，标记分布是核心任务/方法线索。"},{"keyword_id":"knowledge-distillation","exact_quote":"we introduce a novel knowledge distilling strategy to assist visual feature learning in the convolutional neural network for painting style classification.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要提出知识蒸馏策略辅助CNN视觉特征学习，并以软标签蒸馏互补信息，符合教师信号迁移/知识蒸馏定义。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"a multi-factor distribution is employed as soft-labels to distill complementary information with visual input, which extracts from different historical context via label distribution learning.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要将视觉输入与历史语境多因子分布作为互补信息联合蒸馏，体现多视图/多模态观测变量联合利用。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","reason_zh":"摘要仅提到风格继承、发展或突变的历史连续性，但未明确说明显式建模标签间共现或依赖结构；软标签分布本身不足以确认。"}],"input_issues":[]}
